history.sg_progress: The promulgation of the administrative instruction governing the functioning of the property survey board has been delayed due to the need for policy consistency, further consultations with key property management components and other stakeholders, and the prioritization of peace operations undergoing downsizing or liquidation. Finalizing the administrative instruction remains a priority; however, deeper consultations were necessary with various asset management offices to ensure alignment between the policy and existing guidance documents. In addition, the immediate focus on mission drawdowns and closures and the review of property cases generated by those drawdowns and closures contributed to the delay. To complete the process, the Headquarters Property Survey Board, in coordination with stakeholders and the Global Asset Management Policy Service, is incorporating feedback into the draft administrative instruction. Barring any unforeseen delays, completion is anticipated for the first quarter of 2026.
